_README: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR D5(b). One member, one model, one key.
N - 1: SIX MEMBERS, FIVE DISTINCT MODELS. The sixth runs the D2(b) v1 pass on a
model already in the battery: 'to compare two prompt versions you hold the model
fixed; to compare models you hold the prompt fixed.'
mid    A  rohit_panda   anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5          v2
mid    B  huang_yu      openai/gpt-4.1-mini                 v2
mid    C  xia_yanran    google/gemini-2.5-flash             v2
cheap  D  li_yunke      qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507           v2
cheap  E  shen_bowen    deepseek/deepseek-v3.2              v2
cheap  D  zhao_yujia    qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507           v1  <- mirrors D
THREE MID, TWO CHEAP, FIVE FAMILIES. Both of the brief's conditions are checked in
code by validate_roster(): the v2 set spans two price tiers, and no two v2 members
share a family. Mistral is deliberately absent - the judge
(mistralai/mistral-small-2603) must never grade a family on this roster.
WHY THIS ROSTER REPLACED THE LAST ONE (2026-09-13). The previous battery on
meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct scored 1/60. Three harness defects explained most
of that, all now fixed: the transcript never replayed the model's own calls (48/60
halted on duplicate_action), the parser broke on replies holding two JSON objects,
and the model was never told which claim it was deciding. With those fixed, the
cheapest models were also the weakest candidates, so every row was upgraded within
its tier band. Rohit Panda moved to Haiku 4.5 by choice; Shen Bowen and Zhao Yujia
moved because that choice forced them to.
TIER IS ASSIGNED BY MEASURED BATTERY COST, anchored on the brief's section 7:
cheap  <= US$0.48   (brief cheap reference 0.10/0.40 costs $0.148 on our tokens)
mid    <= US$3.00   (brief mid reference 1.00/5.00 costs $1.579)
frontier > US$3.00  (brief frontier reference costs $7.896 - and is refused)
Costed on OUR measured tokens - 18,190 in / 542 out per trial from results/scripted/
- with x3 on output, because a scripted transcript is a FLOOR on what a live model
writes. The v2 process section adds ~860 tokens per turn that this basis does not
include; the canary measures the real figure before anyone commits to 60 trials.
VERIFIED 2026-09-13 against the LIVE OpenRouter /models endpoint. Every id exists
and advertises tool calling. Model ids are not guessable: slugs taken from web
listings have been wrong five times on this project.
MAX_TOKENS_PER_CALL is 1536 and the invariant below must match config.py, or
assert_invariants refuses every run.
RE-VERIFY BEFORE THE BATTERY:  python3 evals/check_roster_prices.py
trials_expected is DERIVED from the fixtures and merely cross-checked against the
number below. If they disagree the roster is wrong, never the derivation.
battery_tag is resolved to a commit SHA at runtime. Cut the tag, then nobody runs
until `git rev-list -n1 <tag>` equals their HEAD.
trial_policy: 30 ordinary x1 + 10 negative x3 = 60 (derived; see battery_provenance.plan_shape)

expected._note: Filled by `python3 run_battery.py --freeze` once, at the frozen commit. Every later run compares against these and refuses on a mismatch, naming the component that moved.

members._note: MODEL A, mid tier. Moved from meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct on 2026-09-13. The Llama batteries are archived in results/archive/live/ with what each measured.
MODEL B, mid tier. Upgraded from gpt-4o-mini.
MODEL C, mid tier. Has an optional reasoning mode; we send reasoning.enabled=false. Confirm the canary's measured cost matches the estimate before typing yes.
MODEL D, cheap tier. zhao_yujia's v1 pass runs on this same model.
MODEL E, cheap tier. Moved off anthropic/claude-3-haiku because rohit_panda now holds the Anthropic family, and no two v2 members may share one.

THE v1 PASS. Mirrors li_yunke on a cheap model, as the brief requires ('on the cheap tier only'), rather than following rohit_panda onto Haiku 4.5. qwen3-235b is strong enough for v1 and v2 to differ; on an 8B model both would score near zero and D2(b) would measure nothing. Its family duplicating li_yunke's is correct: the family rule applies to the five v2 models.
